title: ChargerRequest
description: Command issued by the FCS to a charger controller on the device request topic.

requesterId.description: Session or system that issued the request, e.g. fa_session_123

requestId.description: Optional correlation ID for tracking this request against a status response

command.description: reserve = hold slot for incoming robot; start_charge = begin charging; stop_charge = stop charging; release = free the slot

robotId.description: Robot this command applies to. Required for reserve and start_charge.
